transcript: I'm seeing the Lost Boys musical tomorrow, and so in preparation, I watched the film tonight, which I had never seen. And having now seen the film, I am like 10 times more excited to see the musical because how do you do any of that on stage? Like, going into it, I knew it was about vampires, that was pretty much it. But I was expecting more like Twilight and not like a full on action movie. Like, they're going to need Stranger Things: the first shadow level effects to pull this off. There's like flying, there's full on action sequences, there's fighting, there's blood, and like full on body horror. And on top of that, it's just like pure 80s camp. And so the question becomes, how do you translate that to a 2026 audience? The movie itself is very theatrical, though. Like, I get why someone watched this film and was like, we should put that on stage. Now, why a musical? I'm not entirely sure, but I am going in with an open mind cause I do think it can work. Because if they can pull this off, this is going to be one of the most insane shows Broadway has ever seen. And honestly, even if they can't, I can't wait to see them try.
